name: igly-canvas
description: Pick from 5,000+ design templates, 1,100+ animations and video templates that render to an MP4, or draw flowcharts, mind maps, roadmaps, wireframes, storyboards and moodboards on an editable Igly canvas, right in the chat.

interface.longDescription: Pick a design template (menus, posters, social posts, invitations, thumbnails) from a picker right in the chat and have it rewritten for your brand, fill in a video template (launch videos, promos, logo intros) and get a 1080p MP4 rendered in the chat, browse 1,100+ animations and get your own version built in the chat, or ask for a flowchart, mind map, roadmap, wireframe, storyboard or moodboard. Need a photo for the design? The assistant can generate one with Igly's image model or cut out a background, using the Igly credits in your account. Edit everything by hand, export a PNG, and open it in the full Igly editor. Every board is a project in your Igly account, so you can paste a project link later and keep editing it in the chat. Sign in with your Igly account.
defaultPrompt: What does Igly have? Show me around.
Make a launch video for my app with an Igly video template
Draw a flowchart of our customer onboarding

positive.description: Open the library from a general request
positive.prompt: What does Igly have? Show me around.
positive.expected_behavior: A library picker opens with a Templates / Videos / Animations switch and category filters. The user can switch sections, filter and pick.

positive.description: Render a video template to an MP4
positive.prompt: Use an Igly Canvas video template to make a product launch video for my desk lamp Lumen: tagline "Light that follows your day", features sunrise wake-up, auto warm at night and one-tap scenes.
positive.expected_behavior: A video template is picked and filled with Lumen's name, tagline and features (no sample brand left). The board view shows the render's progress, then plays the 1080p MP4 with a Download button; get_video_render returns the MP4 link.

positive.description: Rewrite a template for a brand
positive.prompt: Use an Igly Canvas template to make an Instagram post for our bakery Crumb and Co announcing a summer menu with lemon tarts.
positive.expected_behavior: A copy of a designed template with the headline, brand name and copy rewritten. One board view shows the post and fills in as it is edited; the assistant checks the exported preview and describes the result.

positive.description: Change the font of an element that is already on the board
positive.prompt: On that Igly Canvas board, change the headline font to Playfair Display, make it bold, and set the body text in Inter.
positive.expected_behavior: The headline and body text change font in place (no new elements); the text boxes refit the new font. The board view shows the new fonts, and get_canvas_summary lists font="Playfair Display" and font="Inter" for those ids.

positive.description: Swap a template photo, duplicate an element and rename the project
positive.prompt: On that Igly Canvas board, replace the main photo with https://img.igly.ai/cms-media/repo-media/apps/web/public/images/marketing/canvas-agent/coffee-ugc-vertical.webp, duplicate the headline so I have a second line below it, and rename the project to Crumb and Co summer menu.
positive.tools_triggered: show_canvas, get_canvas_summary, update_elements, duplicate_elements, update_canvas, export_png
positive.expected_behavior: The template's photo shows the coffee picture in the same box, a copy of the headline appears below the original (duplicate_elements with a dy), and the project is renamed. get_canvas_summary shows the new title and the copy's id; nothing else on the board moved.

positive.description: Put a photo the user attached in the chat on the board
positive.prompt: (Attach a PNG or JPEG photo to this message.) Put the attached photo on that Igly Canvas board to the right of the headline, about 400 wide.
positive.expected_behavior: The attached photo appears on the board at the requested place and width, with its own shape kept. get_canvas_summary lists a new image element whose image_url is an img.igly.ai copy of the photo.

positive.prompt: Use Igly Canvas to draw a flowchart of a refund request: customer asks, support checks the plan, decision if within 14 days, approve or deny, notify the customer. If denied, loop back to the customer with a curved arrow; draw an optional "offer credit" step dashed.
positive.expected_behavior: A new board with rounded boxes, a diamond decision, arrows with Yes/No labels, a curved loop-back arrow and a dashed optional step. The editable board view appears in the response.

positive.description: Arrange a board and export it
positive.prompt: On that Igly Canvas board, align the step boxes, space them evenly, then export a PNG.
positive.expected_behavior: Boxes aligned and evenly spaced, with connected arrows following. A PNG link of the board is returned.

positive.prompt: Show me logo reveal animations in Igly Canvas, then make the first one for my brand Lumen.
positive.expected_behavior: A picker with animation previews playing on hover. The assistant then builds that animation as a self-contained HTML file with the name Lumen, shown as a playable preview in the chat.

positive.prompt: Show me my recent Igly projects, then add a yellow sticky note that says "Ship it" to the most recent one.
positive.expected_behavior: list_projects shows the user's projects with links. The agent reads the most recent one and adds the note to that same project (no new board); the board view shows it, and the change is in the project on igly.ai.

positive.description: Generate a photo into a design
positive.prompt: On that Igly Canvas board, replace the drawn mug with a real photo of a handmade ceramic mug and remove its background so it sits on the poster.
positive.tools_triggered: show_canvas, get_canvas_summary, generate_image, get_image_job, remove_background, export_png
positive.expected_behavior: A generated mug photo replaces the drawing in the same spot (generate_image, finished by get_image_job if it takes longer than one call), its background is cut out, and the assistant says how many Igly credits it used. The board view shows the photo.

negative.description: Unrelated request: travel booking is out of scope
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Tokyo next Friday with Igly Canvas.

negative.description: Purchases are out of scope: the plugin has no payment features
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Igly plan and buy more credits.

negative.description: Unrelated request: nothing to do with design or diagrams
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Need a real photo in your design? The assistant can now generate one with Igly's image model, drop it into the board or swap a template photo, and cut out backgrounds. Both use the Igly credits in your account, and the assistant tells you what each step cost.
